headline: The served deploy-history ledger is now independently fetched and compared, not just validated locally — anchored by a reproducible digest that cannot create a receipt/manifest cycle.

items.title: Independent served-ledger comparison
items.insight: The --remote checker fetched only the head receipt; the chronology ledger was trusted from the local copy. It now fetches the served NDJSON, re-validates the chain from scratch, and requires served depth, head, and canonical digest to match the published anchor.

items.title: Reproducible continuity anchor
items.insight: api/staging-deploy-continuity.json publishes depth, genesis, head lineage, and the SHA-256 of the canonical ledger render, with a source-derived generatedAt so it is byte-stable across rebuilds and only advances on a genuinely new deploy head.

items.title: Structural cycle-guard by construction
items.insight: The producer asserts its artifact is not in the candidate manifest's CORE_PATHS, so publishing it can never move candidateRoot and feed back into the receipt it describes. Cycle-freedom is proven by a self-test, not left to convention.

items.title: Un-cascaded-publisher drift root-fixed
items.insight: A rebase past 27 hourly-Action commits left public-intelligence.json (a CORE_PATHS leaf) drifted without its candidate->release->status->citation cascade, so build:check was RED on a clean tree. A full canonical npm run build resynced it — no floor lowered, no data fabricated.

followUps: Generalize the anchor+compare pattern into a served-surface continuity registry across every critical CORE_PATHS served artifact.
Add a ledger monotonicity tripwire that alarms if served ledger depth ever decreases.
Verify the canonical protocol propagation repair on the next studio-ops drain.
blockers: Production promotion remains held on genuine identity, provider, control-plane, and recovery evidence.
Production Worker routes remain 0/5 matched and RUM evidence remains unavailable; neither was backfilled.

honestyLedger.title: No production promotion
honestyLedger.why: Green staging does not grant auth/security authority or replace real-provider evidence; the interlock was preserved.

honestyLedger.title: Continuity kept out of the release cascade
honestyLedger.why: Release proof already binds ledger depth/head; entangling the continuity digest there is marginal churn on public proof surfaces (D-S299.1).

honestyLedger.title: Three cross-repo/external items deferred with evidence
honestyLedger.why: Protocol-repair not yet propagated, skill-trace control-plane-owned with 12 cargo outstanding, RUM re-eval external — recorded as carries, never re-shipped, forked, or backfilled.

amortization.verdict: one in-repo actionable item shipped with four second-order innovations; in-repo genius list exhausted, three items honestly deferred
